about: Made-up reports labelled by priority, used to TRAIN the priority classifier (app/reporting/priority_model.py). Separate from the evaluation sets in backend/evaluation, which the model never trains on. Labelled with the same rules as docs/EVALUATION.md: high = violence or a threat of it, sexual assault or unwanted touching, stalking, weapons, risk of self-harm, or a serious danger to safety; medium (shown as Moderate) = harassment, bullying, discrimination, intimidation, retaliation, fraud or theft; low = everything else. Written by the developer, so they share the developer's way of writing: see docs/LIMITATIONS.md.
